# Vernet

> Vernet is a free and open-source network diagnostics app for discovering devices, monitoring servers, waking compatible devices, calculating IPv4 and IPv6 subnets, checking ports, testing internet speed, and using ping and DNS tools.

## Features

- Discover devices on a Wi-Fi network and inspect switch neighbors with CDP and LLDP.
- Monitor ICMP, TCP, HTTP, and HTTPS server availability with history and down alerts.
- Wake compatible devices with Wake on LAN.
- Calculate IPv4 and IPv6 network addresses, masks, ranges, and subnet sizes from CIDR input.
- Scan ports, test internet speed, run ping checks, and look up DNS records.
